what: El Nino years used by the robustness strip of the Indonesia record page (variant: the change without El Nino years).
source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, Oceanic Nino Index (ONI): 3-month running mean of ERSST.v5 sea surface temperature anomalies in the Nino 3.4 region
rule: A year is an El Nino year when its July-September (JAS) ONI is +0.5 or more.
note: The values are copied from the ANOM column of the table as fetched; NOAA revises recent seasons. The list is the rule applied to jas_oni and is checked by src/lib/robust.test.ts. The science review of this project (docs/research-v3/J2-science-judge.md) states no rule; this one was fixed before the numbers were computed.

not_used_by_the_app.why: Kept to show that the list depends on the season chosen: with September-November (SON) and the same threshold, 2006 and 2019 also count.
